Forever Steel: Steel Pipe Supplier for Global Projects
Forever Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd supplies steel pipe and pipe fittings for oil and gas, water transmission, piling, structural and industrial projects. Our main product range includes seamless steel pipe, welded steel pipe, OCTG products, coated pipe, steel plates and pipe fittings.
We support international buyers with controlled sourcing, production coordination, inspection management, documentation control and export delivery. With a focus on product quality, stable supply and practical project service, Forever Steel works with customers across energy, infrastructure, marine, mechanical and industrial applications.
Production Capacity and Delivery Support
 Forever Steel supports steel pipe and pipe fitting supply through coordinated production, quality control, documentation management and export delivery. From raw material preparation to manufacturing follow-up, inspection review, packing and shipment arrangement, we work to keep project orders under clear control.Our strength lies in responsive communication, flexible supply coordination and practical execution support. For customers handling project-based procurement, this means easier follow-up on technical requirements, inspection schedules, documentation review and delivery planning.With a focus on stable production support and controlled shipment execution, Forever Steel helps buyers improve supply efficiency across industrial and energy applications. 
Read More +
Workshop & Quality Control
Forever Steel applies quality control throughout raw material inspection, production, testing and pre-shipment review. We support buyers with clear product identification, traceable records and inspection coordination for project supply.Mill Test Certificates (MTC), inspection records and related documentation help verify material grade, chemical composition, mechanical properties, heat number and other key quality data required for technical review and delivery control.
Read More +

Inspection of Raw Materials
Verification of dimensions and tolerances, assessment of visual quality, testing of mechanical characteristics, evaluation of weight, and examination of raw materials.
Inspection of Semi-Finished Products
Throughout the pipe manufacturing process, we conduct Ultrasonic Testing, Magnetic Particle Inspection, Radiographic Examination, Liquid Penetrant Testing, and Eddy Current Testing.
Inspection of Finished Products
Once the finished products are ready, our expert Quality Assurance team will carry out both visual examinations and physical testing.
Pre-Shipment Inspection
Prior to the dispatch of finished goods, our skilled QC personnel will conduct a final inspection, focusing on the pipe markings and overall contents.
Projects & Cases
Our project and supply experience covers oil and gas, water transmission, offshore, piling and industrial applications across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, South America and Oceania.Forever Steel supports customers with product selection, inspection coordination, documentation control and export delivery for project-based procurement.
